decisions.reason: As a cheese close to the core range that has already been kept and publicly presented for several years, it benefits from management’s tendency to continue an established commitment unless failure is unmistakable.

Although the spicy variant is somewhat more niche and therefore slightly easier to rationalize, it still builds directly on the firm’s established cheese business and prior public commitment supports continuation.
This soft cheese appears to have received the strongest visible launch commitment and fits the firm’s core organic dairy identity well, which makes management relatively likely to persist with it.
